content.value_statement: Teams need a repeatable path from idea to live React site. This skill guides creation, editing, metadata, deployment, and publishing through the Higgsfield CLI.
actual_capabilities: Chooses between standalone website and Higgsfield app flows.
Creates sites with required subdomain and type guidance.
Guides React 19 and TanStack Start edits for Cloudflare Workers.
Adds launch cover, favicon, and marketplace metadata before deployment.
Supports deployment, status checks, and explicit publish steps with the Higgsfield CLI.
limitations: Requires the Higgsfield CLI, git, and bun on the local machine.
Requires user authentication before account, deploy, or publish commands can run.
Standalone website mode does not support AI media generation.
Live deploys are public immediately; there is no preview stage.

use_cases.title: Launch a marketing site
use_cases.description: Create a branded standalone website with custom layout, assets, metadata, and a public deployment.

use_cases.title: Build a Higgsfield app
use_cases.description: Create an authenticated app that uses Higgsfield sign-in, Quanta UI, and fnf generation patterns.

use_cases.title: Ship a production update
use_cases.description: Edit an existing site, verify behavior, update launch assets, deploy, and publish only when requested.

prompt_templates.title: Create a standalone site
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a standalone website for [brand]. Use a clear subdomain, custom visual style, launch metadata, and a public deployment.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Higgsfield app
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a Higgsfield app for [use case]. Include sign-in, Quanta layout, generation flow, result states, and deployment checks.

prompt_templates.title: Improve an existing site
prompt_templates.prompt: Update my Higgsfield website to improve [area]. Keep the current brand, verify mobile layout, refresh metadata, and deploy the result.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare for publishing
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Higgsfield site for launch readiness. Check auth, metadata, cover assets, responsive design, errors, and publish only after approval.

output_examples.input: Build a portfolio site for a motion designer.
output: A branded standalone portfolio with project sections, responsive layout, launch cover, favicon, and metadata.
A live public URL after deployment and a short summary of what changed.

output_examples.input: Create an app that generates product mood boards.
output: An authenticated Higgsfield app with Quanta interface, generation form, upload flow, job states, and result gallery.
A deployed app with user-safe error states and no secret values exposed in chat.

output_examples.input: Refresh the home page and publish it.
output: Updated page copy, layout, cover assets, metadata, and verification before deployment.
Publishing proceeds only after the user clearly confirms the listing step.

best_practices: Decide website or app type before creation; ask one question when unclear.
Keep secrets and scoped tokens out of chat, source files, and commits.
Deploy only after metadata, cover assets, type checks, and visual review are complete.
anti_patterns: Creating a site without choosing the required product type.
Adding Higgsfield generation to standalone website mode.
Publishing before live URL, metadata, and cover assets are verified.

faq.question: Does this skill create both websites and apps?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports standalone websites and Higgsfield-integrated apps, selected through the required type choice.

faq.question: Can standalone websites use AI generation?
faq.answer: No. AI media generation belongs to Higgsfield app mode with sign-in and fnf SDK patterns.

faq.question: Does it deploy the site?
faq.answer: Yes. It guides deployment through the Higgsfield CLI and returns the live public URL.

faq.question: Does publishing happen automatically?
faq.answer: No. Publishing to the community feed happens only after the user explicitly asks for it.

faq.question: Can I use this with Claude, Codex, or Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What local tools are required?
faq.answer: The workflow expects the Higgsfield CLI, git, and bun, plus an authenticated Higgsfield account for protected actions.
